crossRefs.note: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t…
I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
“The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, the Mighty One, God, Yahweh, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or…
won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked…
God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to…
I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I…

translations.web: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
translations.bsb: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!
translations.kjv: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
translations.asv: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
